prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1422
Claimant:
Dawn Simmons
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
2023-07-25
The insured reported a collision at an intersection while turning left across oncoming traffic, and the claim was
opened the same day. The insured is named on the policy, and the policy was in force at the time of loss.
2023-08-02
Contact was made with the other driver, who described the crash in the same way the insured did. Both drivers
agreed the other vehicle was approaching from the opposite direction.
2023-09-07
Two independent witensses at a nearby business gave statements that match the sequence of events reported by
both drivers. Their accounts were taken separately and were consistent with each other.
2023-09-16
Scene photographs were received from the insured and show damage to the front of the insured vehicle and the
driver side of the other vehicle. The damage pattern lines up with a left turn into the path of the other car.
2023-09-27
The insured vehicle was inspected at a repair facility. The damage is consistent with the impact described, and no
earlier damage was noted on the vehicle or in prior claim history.
2023-10-08
The claimant, who was a passenger in the other vehicle, reported a head injury and was taken to hospital for
evaluation. A concussion was diagnosed and the claimant was discharged with follow-up instructions.
2023-10-20
The claimant has retained a lawyer, who has asked that all further contact go through that office. Future requests will
be sent to counsel.
2023-10-29
The claimant described the crash in the same way in each conversation so far, including the initial call and the
recorded statement. Medical records show no earlier injury to the same area of the head.
2023-11-13
The claimant's treatment has continued for somewhat longer than is typical for a concussion of this kind. The records
show ongoing symptom management, and the clinical notes describe the injury as fitting the force of the collision.
2023-11-23
It is still not fully clear from the records and photographs where the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the moment
of impact. The adjuster has requested seating details and any additional photographs from counsel.
2024-01-02
Based on the current file, the reported injury and vehilce damage fit the crash as described, and nothing so far
suggests the damage predates coverage. The file will remain open pending the seating information and updated
medical records.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
